### BackpackCompensationScenarios - Smoke, Atlas, 4 row(s)

Fixture: -

- ``BackpackTypes_CustomMapping_RoundTripsThroughTree`` — [regression, red-first]
  A custom three-type BackpackTypes mapping survives ToTreeAttribute then FromTreeAttribute, with its derived BackpackMapping flattened correctly.
  pins: A server BackpackTypes edit actually reaches a client that reads the world-config tree.
  evidence: Failed before the fix, when ToTree emitted no BackpackTypes key and the client kept the property-initializer default.
- ``BackpackTypes_AbsentKey_KeepsDefault`` — [control]
  A tree with the BackpackTypes key removed keeps the property-initializer default mapping (hunterbackpack to small, backpack-normal to large).
  pins: Older saves and pre-fix trees still behave, so the explicit serializer is backward-compatible.
- ``BackpackTypes_ExplicitEmpty_StaysEmpty`` — [control]
  A present-but-empty BackpackTypes section round-trips as empty in both BackpackTypes and BackpackMapping, distinct from the absent-key default.
  pins: The null-versus-empty distinction the explicit serializer exists to preserve, letting a user deliberately map no backpacks.
- ``SelectionModeNone_ResolvesNoBackpackGroup`` — [regression]
  With a worn hunter backpack, BackpackSelectionMode.None returns the no-backpack group and hides the rendered slot, while LastFound still resolves backpack-small.
  pins: None is genuinely a no-compensation mode, not a fall-through to the selection switch default arm.

### CarryabilitySyncWiringTests - Sync/Network, Plain, 4 row(s)

Fixture: -

- ``CarryabilitySync_InvalidatesClientRenderCaches`` *(Fact - 1 row(s))* — [contract, red-first]
  RebuildClientDerivedState must call EntityCarryRenderer.InvalidateRenderCaches after swapping the transform template manager.
  pins: The carryability sync invalidates the client's render caches, the wiring half of the stale-pose fix.
  evidence: Failed on the unfixed head with the render-cache invalidation call absent from the method's enumerated calls.
  decision: 25
- ``ReloadFromFile_GatesOnTheBootLatch_NotTheLiveFlag`` *(Fact - 1 row(s))* — [contract, red-first]
  ReloadFromFile must read the boot-time recondition latch and must not read the reloaded file's own flag.
  pins: The reload gate is the boot latch, so a mid-session file edit cannot switch the session's mode.
  evidence: Failed on the unfixed head by reading the live flag getter at the reload gate instead of the boot latch.
- ``CaptureGate_IsSeededFromTheSameBootLatchAsTheReloadGate`` *(Fact - 1 row(s))* — [contract]
  CarrySystem.AssetsFinalize must seed the conditioning capture gate from the boot latch, and ReloadFromFile must not re-enable it.
  pins: The capture gate cannot drift from the reload gate, so a Mode A session can never reach a restore with an empty baseline.
- ``CarryabilityStateSync_ContainsEveryEntry_AndAlwaysRebuildsDerivedState`` *(Fact - 1 row(s))* — [contract, red-first]
  OnCarryabilityStateSync must wrap its loop in a finally reaching the derived-state rebuild, apply entries through TryApplyEntry, and catch and warn inside it.
  pins: One malformed entry cannot wedge the client: the per-entry boundary catches and the derived state always rebuilds.
  evidence: Failed on the unfixed head with no finally region reaching the derived-state rebuild and entries applied inline.
